description: This file is a shell script containing functions for managing git repository states, including setting, saving, verifying, and restoring file contents and the repository head.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the content of a file in the worktree and stages it in index.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current worktree and index contents of a file into backup files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a file and then saves its current state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that a file's worktree and index contents match expected values.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved state matches the current worktree and index contents.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD commit hash.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the saved HEAD hash matches the current HEAD.
